_readme: Settings for world-clock. Push a change to the board with:
Every key is optional -- delete this file and the app runs on its compiled
defaults (the eight zones below, Toronto home). Wi-Fi credentials are NOT
here: they live in lib/board/secrets.h, gitignored and compiled in.
zones      first entry is HOME (press the knob to jump to it). name is at
most 12 chars, uppercase reads best. tz is a POSIX TZ string --
the same format as desk-clock's timezone -- so DST rules travel
with the config. Up to 16 zones.
brightness day/night backlight duty, 8-255. Night is judged by HOME's clock.
night      hours (0-23) the night brightness applies; wraps midnight.
